title: Industrial cybersecurity

Automotive and energy are two of WhiteGuard's nine declared vertical specializations, served by a fifty-strong team of cybersecurity specialists.

industrialAutomotiveBattlefieldBand.headline: Automotive cybersecurity
industrialAutomotiveBattlefieldBand.intro: Automotive cybersecurity is one of WhiteGuard's nine declared vertical specializations. The program spans three battlefields at once: the connected vehicle, the manufacturing line that builds it, and the dealer-network systems that sell and service it. WhiteGuard's automotive cybersecurity covers all three: telematics and over-the-air update channels, plant-floor robotics and ECU programming stations, and dealer-management systems holding customer and vehicle data. Generic industrial security solutions designed for general manufacturing are not enough. Automotive needs purpose-built controls.

industrialManufacturingCyberBand.headline: Manufacturing cybersecurity
industrialManufacturingCyberBand.intro: Manufacturing cybersecurity has one job that beats every other metric: keep the line running. A ransomware event taking a line down costs more per hour than most IT budgets carry per quarter. WhiteGuard's manufacturing cybersecurity and OT Cybersecurity programs serve regional industrial clients and deliver IT/OT segmentation, continuous OT monitoring through WhiteHawk's defensive module, Business Continuity & Recovery, and the GRC evidence auditors demand.

features.title: IT/OT segmentation
features.description: Zones and conduits reduce blast radius between corporate systems and plant-floor control networks

features.title: Business continuity
features.description: Recovery planning keeps production decisions practical when ransomware pressure is highest.

industrialOilGasCyberBand.headline: Oil & Gas Cybersecurity
industrialOilGasCyberBand.intro: Oil & Gas Cybersecurity and Energy Cybersecurity protect the highest-stakes attack surface in the region. SCADA, drilling control rooms, refinery DCS, pipeline telemetry, and LNG-terminal automation are all valid targets, and a successful attack causes physical-world consequences far beyond data loss.

illustrationCard.subtitle: Threat detection follows industrial telemetry from control room to pipeline and SOC response.
